inheritance.resolver: Inherit every surface/dynamic/contract/family mapping and original acceptance ID from the two hash-locked ledgers. Add only these selected local outcomes/witnesses; historical evidence remains unchanged.
inheritance.closure_rule: After final frozen gates and independent review, resolve only the selected local obligation pointers listed below. All other shared-owner obligations and every full-family status remain inherited/open.

public_delta.note: Example-only helper outside package exports/files; no public wheel engine or browser polyfill.

sticky-layout.outcome: Existing native column owner implements measured leading physical-left pinning, actual cell starts/spacing, preview/cancel, hidden/reordered prefix, responsive roots, narrow visible representatives, bounded viewport/progressive row reuse and owned cleanup. Literal authored style text is restored only when nonowned styles are unchanged after owned property restoration.

native-topology.outcome: Immutable full column state adds pinned without splitting/cloning native header/body/footer cells. All visible members must be pinned for a cell to stick; mixed spans stay in normal flow. Existing nodes, spans and editable identities remain.

height-controls.outcome: Existing height geometry remains inherited unchanged. This delta adds primary-axis wheel-boundary acceptance only, with no new height owner.

action-reveal.outcome: Authored CSS plus the page-owned wheel guard preserves both primary-axis boundary directions. Trusted native-auto positive controls establish that parent scrolling is possible without the guard.
action-reveal.supersedes: Inherited CSS-only containment wording is not evidence of the tested Windows Firefox/WebKit wheel outcome.

row-details.outcome: Full and reduced Name/Salary authored templates reuse employeeDetail(view), shared Rows, validation/navigation and Popup lifetime; omitted fields stay unchanged and reopened pages use current values.
row-details.retained_cross_owner: General Popup retained/preloaded/drag/guard and declaration parity stays with popup/page U13/U15/U16.

row-lifecycle.outcome: Row resources release narrow probes with their records. Hooks mark geometry dirty without per-yield forced reads; final placement measures before bind completion. Independent owners restore their properties/markers and cancel queued work. After restoring owned position/left values and priorities, literal authored style text is restored only if the remaining normalized style matches the original; foreign application style changes survive.
row-lifecycle.retained_cross_owner: Local/shared callback and declaration composition stays with core C08/C13.

selected_local_obligations.state: Final frozen verification pending. Local outcomes alone do not close a complete family.

witnesses.title_validation: Exact literal titles/templates resolve in current source; dimension lists explicitly expand every generated instance. Source presence is not an execution pass.

native_css_boundary_evidence.scope: Observed Windows Playwright Firefox155.0 and WebKit26.6 only; no universal browser/future-version claim.
native_css_boundary_evidence.conclusion: Firefox accepted/computed contain but still chained trusted targeted boundary wheel input. Windows WebKit reported no CSS support and also chained. CSS-only success was not assumed or waived.
native_css_boundary_evidence.raw_preservation: Compact measured facts and raw SHA-256 values are retained here. Complete raw experiment preservation belongs to the final verification receipt; listed cache paths describe their location at review.

implemented_recipe.primary_axis: Larger absolute wheel delta; ties use vertical.
preserves: nested auto/scroll descendants with primary-axis capacity
implemented_recipe.blocks: Prevent wheel default only when the root and eligible descendants cannot move in the primary direction.
implemented_recipe.limits: Bounded wheel example; no general touch/overscroll/RTL input polyfill or public utility package.

geometry_limits: Physical-left/LTR, ordinary untransformed native tables and one horizontal sticky owner. Ancestor row groups may have separate vertical stickiness.
A pin prefix wider than the scrollport retains native clipping/containing-block limits. Preferred widths are not measured offsets.
A narrower mounted representative can replace a wider static group. No COL geometry or new leaf-header requirement is imposed.
